stewardFix.reviewFailsClosed: review_comparable() now forces AMBIGUOUS when the agreed verdict is NARROWER_OR_EQUAL but prohibitions_covered is false. A child can only activate when the review explicitly confirmed the parent's prohibitions survived; a model that waves a widening child through while admitting the prohibitions were not covered can no longer activate it.
stewardFix.evidenceGate: judgment.all_evidence_available() decides, deterministically, whether every submitted evidence URL was fetched and returned a non-empty body. It rides inside the strict_eq comparable as evidence_ok and is re-applied after consensus by core.gate_use_by_evidence(), so a substantive WITHIN_SCOPE/OUT_OF_SCOPE is downgraded to INCONCLUSIVE unless every side agrees the evidence was readable. A failed fetch is never approval.
stewardFix.useRecord: prove_use records now carry evidence_ok, so the UI and any auditor can see whether a verdict rested on readable evidence.
stewardFix.ci: genvm-lint check is now a blocking CI gate (GENVM_VERSION pinned), not continue-on-error.

bondLifecycle.summary: A real, nonzero GEN bond was posted, an adverse verdict slashed it, and the contract credited the split to the parent's grantor and the treasury -- all on chain. claim() then executed and zeroed the ledger, but the platform skipped and refunded the outgoing value transfer, so no GEN has actually left the contract. See externalPayout below.

steps.action: request_review g2 with value 10000000000000000 (0.01 GEN), sent by the child's grantor
steps.result: bond accepted (msg.value attached), verdict EXPANDS_AUTHORITY, full bond slashed
grantor 9000000000000000 (0.009 GEN), treasury 1000000000000000 (0.001 GEN) -- a real 90/10 split of a nonzero bond
EXPANDS_AUTHORITY, slashed; treasury claimable rises to 2000000000000000 (0.002 GEN)

steps.action: contract balance while both bonds are held and before any payout
steps.result: 20000000000000000 (0.02 GEN) -- the contract really custodies the posted bonds

externalPayout.status: NOT delivered on Studio Dev -- value transfer skipped and refunded by the platform

claimCalls.fees: no message allocation (the CLI-style fee distribution only)
claimCalls.result: claim() executed SUCCESS and zeroed the ledger, but the emitted transfer was skipped: message_value_effects declaredBudget 0, skipped true, skippedRefunded true

claimCalls.fees: Studio sim_estimateTransactionFees messageAllocations (messageType internal, recipient grantor, budget 120000000000010352)
claimCalls.result: FINALIZED, leader execution SUCCESS, yet message_value_effects for the emitted value still shows declaredBudget 0, skipped true, skippedRefundedAmount 9000000000000000. The message fee budget was refunded, the value stayed in the contract.

externalPayout.effect: After both claims the contract balance is 20000000000000000 (0.02 GEN) and neither participant's EOA balance rose by the slashed amount. The 0.009 GEN credited to the grantor's internal ledger is real state, but the pull-payment emit_transfer does not deliver value on this network build.
externalPayout.why: gl.chain.Account(...).emit_transfer() emits the value message with its own fee budget of 0. On Studio Dev that message is skipped and its value refunded inside the contract; the fee deposit attached at submission (even a Studio-estimated messageAllocations entry) does not change the emitted message's declared budget. This is the platform-level reason the prior session could not prove a payout, now pinned to a specific receipt field rather than to a missing CLI flag.
externalPayout.conclusion: The bond/slash/credit lifecycle is proven live. The external payout is not: no GEN left the contract. claim() logic, ledger zeroing and the pull-payment shape are exercised, but the value delivery is blocked by the platform.

notProvenLive: External value delivery (GEN actually leaving the contract). See externalPayout.

The fail-closed review rule (NARROWER_OR_EQUAL over prohibitions_covered=false -> AMBIGUOUS) and the evidence-gate downgrade are proven by the test suite, not by a live adverse-verdict run: forcing a model to return exactly those contradictory shapes on demand is not reproducible on chain. Their plumbing is visible live (prohibitions_covered is read back; evidence_ok is computed true/false), but the specific downgrades were not triggered on chain.
